WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_price,
    AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0
             THEN CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / Milliseconds 
             END) as avg_ratio
  FROM Track 
  WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_ratio
  FROM album_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  a.AlbumId,
  a.avg_price,
  a.avg_ratio,
  a.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio as difference
FROM album_stats a
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE o.overall_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN a.avg_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  a.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
